description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows one classical Chinese quote in the sidebar, appends an encouragement card after each assistant reply, and provides a quote wall with attribution checks covering 13 authors and 39 quotes. The corpus ships as local data with no API key and no network access. A standalone zero-dependency MCP server over the same corpus (7 tools, 4 resources) is included for reuse in other agents.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧栏每日一条名人名句，每轮回复后附一张应时而变的鼓励卡，并提供带出处核查的语录墙，覆盖 13 位人物、39 条名句。语料以本地数据随包发布，无需 API key、无需联网。同时附带零依赖的独立 MCP server（7 个工具、4 个资源），暴露同一份语料，可供其他宿主复用。
